schema.name: annotations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "annotations" (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`document_id` text NOT NULL,
	`author_id` text NOT NULL,
	`page` integer NOT NULL,
	`x` integer NOT NULL,
	`y` integer NOT NULL,
	`shape` text DEFAULT 'note' NOT NULL,
	`color` text DEFAULT '#c85c35' NOT NULL,
	`body` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`visibility` text DEFAULT 'public' NOT NULL,
	`allow_discussion` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`anchor_text` text,
	`anchor_rects` text,
	`companion_document_id` text,
	`companion_page` integer,
	`companion_title` text,
	`updated_at` text,
	`created_at` text DEFAULT (current_timestamp) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`companion_document_id`) REFERENCES `documents`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
)

    )

)
